## Schemas introduced by this capability

1 schema(s) exist only when `octo/rentals` is active.

### `RentalDuration`

- **id** (string (uuid), optional): Unique identifier for this resource. Example: `"e7cc8bb4-8d1c-4848-8824-5dbedb718681"`.
- **duration** (string, optional): Duration value. Example: `"2"`.
- **durationAmount** (number, optional): Duration amount numeric value. Example: `220.0`.
- **durationUnit** (string, optional): Duration unit value. Example: `"HOUR"`.
- **title** (string, optional): Title value. Example: `"Summer Promotion"`.
- **description** (string, optional): Description value. Example: `"Morning departure with central pickup included."`.

## Integration notes

Behaviour the specification does not carry, from [docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/rentals](https://docs.ventrata.com/capabilities/rentals).

### Routes this capability extends

- `GET /products`
- `GET /products/{productId}`
- `POST /availability`
- `POST /availability/calendar`
- `POST /availability/batch`

- `POST /bookings`

- `POST /bookings/{uuid}/confirm`
- `GET /octo/bookings`

- `POST /octo/bookings/:uuid/extend`

### Where the fields appear

Payload paths the documentation names explicitly — useful when mapping a response onto typed objects:

- `option.rentalDurations[]`
- `booking.rentalDuration`

### Callouts

- **Operations below use the `/octo` prefix.**
- **Always use ids returned by `option.rentalDurations[]`. Unsupported duration units return `INVALID_RENTAL_DURATION_ID`.**
- **Rentals does not add new availability response fields. The selected duration is applied to availability and pricing calculation.**
- **These booking fields are returned on booking write routes above and booking read/cancel/extend routes that serialize bookings (`GET /octo/bookings`, `GET /octo/bookings/:uuid`, `POST /octo/bookings/:uuid/cancel`, `POST /octo/bookings/:uuid/extend`).**
